subject.title: [Feature]: Add screenshot capture button to Control UI chat input (like Doubao)

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated Control UI screenshot capture button now, and what privacy/permission boundary should it use?
rationale: The implementation shape is clear, but screen capture introduces sensitive desktop-content handling and product UX choices that automation should not decide.

options.title: Define security boundary first
options.body: Keep the issue open and require maintainer-approved consent, cancel, preview/removal, logging/redaction, and supported-platform behavior before implementation.

options.title: Accept narrow browser capture
options.body: Proceed with a browser-only static screenshot capture PR that reuses the current attachment path and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Defer to existing attachments
options.body: Do not add a capture button for now and rely on current paste, drop, and file upload until a broader visual-context design is approved.

recommendation.title: Define security boundary first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require maintainer-approved consent, cancel, preview/removal, logging/redaction, and supported-platform behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest recent Control UI/chat routing candidate and is best placed to decide whether this core UI affordance should proceed.
